harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured chrony on the RHEL 7.9 cluster: node1 (10.100.127.10) now acts as the internal time source — it syncs from public pool servers, allows NTP queries from the 10.100.127.0/24 cluster network, serves time via local stratum 10 fallback if upstream is unreachable, and firewalld permits the ntp service. node2 (10.100.127.11) was reconfigured to use only node1 (`server 10.100.127.10 iburst prefer`) as its time source, replacing the public pool servers. Verified node2 syncs against node1 (chronyc sources shows node1's reference ID as the current synced source, marked '*'). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot IDs, issued systemctl reboot (non-blocking), polled until SSH/exec returned, confirmed changed boot IDs and fresh uptime, and verified chronyd was active with persisted config and restored sync on both nodes after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected OS/chrony state on node1 and node2 (RHEL 7.9, chrony 3.4 preinstalled, chronyd active)
Rewrote /etc/chrony.conf on node1: kept pool upstream servers, added allow 10.100.127.0/24 and local stratum 10 for internal-time-source role
Opened firewalld ntp service on node1 and verified UDP 123 listener
Rewrote /etc/chrony.conf on node2: replaced public pool servers with server 10.100.127.10 iburst prefer (node1 only)
Restarted chronyd on both nodes and verified node2 chronyc sources/tracking show node1 as the synced reference
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline on node1 and node2

Restarted node1 via systemctl reboot (backgrounded, ack returned pre-disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified chronyd active, config persisted, and node1 resynced to upstream pool (stratum 2)
Confirmed node2 remained synced to node1 throughout node1's reboot
Restarted node2 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, verified chronyd active, config persisted, and node2 resynced to node1 (stratum 3, reference 0A647F0A)

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as internal time source for the cluster
evidence.summary: node1 chrony.conf updated with allow 10.100.127.0/24 and local stratum 10 fallback; firewalld/UDP 123 open; node1 confirmed synced to upstream pool (stratum 2) providing a stable internal reference

evidence.requirement: node2 configured to sync against node1 instead of a public time server
evidence.summary: node2 chrony.conf rewritten to a single source, server 10.100.127.10, replacing the public pool; chronyc sources/tracking on node2 shows reference ID 0A647F0A (10.100.127.10) as the current synced (*) source
Pre-restart: chronyd active, stratum 2 synced to ntp1.torix.ca, boot_id 9ed9e820-6949-4971-a6a0-9fda0c2ea7ee captured

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node1 unreachable during reboot window; reconnected with new boot_id 447ed045-d4e7-49cc-b316-edcf6217262f and fresh uptime 2026-09-03 12:44:24, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-restart chronyd active, chrony.conf persisted with allow/local-stratum settings, UDP 123 listening, and node1 resynced to upstream pool at stratum 2

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart, including dependency on node1 surviving node1's own restart
evidence.summary: node2 synced to node1 before node1 restarted and remained synced to node1 immediately after node1 came back, boot_id 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a captured pre-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot acknowledged before disconnect; node2 unreachable during reboot window; reconnected with new boot_id c130163d-3f9b-464e-86b1-01571b334b70 and fresh uptime 2026-09-03 12:44:55

evidence.requirement: node2 recovered state/config after restart, confirming persistent sync to node1
evidence.summary: Post-restart chronyd active, chrony.conf persisted with single server 10.100.127.10, and chronyc sources/tracking shows node2 resynced to node1 (reference 0A647F0A, state '*', stratum 3)
